meaning:
παιδευτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(παιδεύω), [in LXX: Hos.5:2 (מוּסָר), Sir.37:19, 4Ma.5:34 4Mac 9:6 * ;]
1. prop., a teacher, instructor: Rom.2:20.
2. a corrector, one who disciplines (cf. Ho, l.with) : Heb.12:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and…
